_meta.description: Grouped Process summing revenue by month on orders.pulse with two overlays anchored on the first month (ref.baseline_index.position 0): OVERLAY_DELTA_VS_BASELINE gives point - baseline in revenue units, OVERLAY_INDEX_VS_BASELINE point / baseline * 100 (July about 194). A position past the series emits PULSE_OVERLAY_REF_UNKNOWN; a zero baseline emits PULSE_OVERLAY_REF_ZERO for the index only. Buffered: the baseline is read from the finished series. Renderers centre the index on 100, the delta on 0.
_meta.name: process-delta-index-vs-baseline
